versions.changelog:
Initial release providing an end-to-end website redesign orchestration skill:

- Introduces a 19-stage redesign pipeline, starting with mandatory dependency installation and self-check (阶段 0)
- Integrates with four required external skills: 建站助手, SEO, GEO, and 网站获客, with strict installation and validation protocol
- Guides users through every step: site audit, user and competitor analysis, information architecture, design strategy, page/component planning, content migration, generation, SEO/GEO/lead-gen, and publishing
- Enforces global rules for platform data interaction and ensures all write operations use validated credentials
- Includes detailed user input requirements and robust operation safeguards for enterprise website overhaul scenarios
